scope: Current 20-parent formal matrix (formal_v2) and all V4 evidence

seal.description: 17-file frozen seal covering provider, checkpoint, norm, attacker, runner, config, queue, worker, cohort, 4×model_config, 4×model_shard1

model_architecture.name: N4 Dual-Branch CausalTCN with Concat Fusion

input_breakdown.features_25d: SC5 streaming features (gripper command/qpos, EEF pos/vel, action deltas, streaks, onsets, variances)
input_breakdown.policy_intent_9d: POLICY_INTENT_ORDER: open_mass, close_mass, open_minus_close_log_mass, entropy, top1_prob, top1_is_open, top1_is_close, best_open_rank, best_close_rank
input_breakdown.gripper_token_9d: TRAIN_G9D_ORDER: close_mass, open_mass, top1_is_close, top1_is_open, top1_prob, best_close_rank, best_open_rank, entropy, open_minus_close_log_mass
input_breakdown.response_proxies_8d: cmd-qpos delta, cmd<0 indicator, qpos diff, close duration, EEF speed, qpos variance, g9d close_mass, g9d open_minus_close_log_mass

calibration.note: Token 31744 maps to raw≈+1.0 (OPEN) via np.clip mechanism. Action sign contract: env+1=CLOSING, env-1=OPENING.

g9d_schema.critical_rule: g9d != p9d (anti-regression). V3 bug was g9d=p9d causing raw_logit explosion to ±1.2M.

training.norm_path: normalization parameters loaded from same training directory

training_labels.label_dependency: label=1 implies candidate_close=True (this is the V4 coupling we must break in N5)

known_limitations.goal_suite_zero_coverage: 0/2593 goal steps have raw_close=0.5 or env_close>0. Clean OpenVLA policy genuinely does not output close on goal tasks. This means V4 detector will NEVER emit on goal suite — not an OOD or model inversion issue.
known_limitations.cc_gate_bottleneck: candidate_close hard gate is the system recall upper bound. P(emit) <= P(raw_gripper <= 0.5).
known_limitations.pgd_true_failure: TRUE PGD only achieves 1/4 of ORACLE attack effect. Most attack budget is lost in the PGD executor, not the detector.
known_limitations.critical_response_conflated: criticality, close intent, and attack exploitability are conflated into a single score. Goal tasks may have critical windows that don't involve close intent.

prohibited_actions: DO NOT modify checkpoint or normalization
DO NOT change tau=0.855 or D_PERSIST=6
DO NOT modify PGD epsilon=0.03, steps=5, K=10
DO NOT modify parent manifest or cohort
DO NOT use any of the 20 formal parents for N5 tuning or threshold selection
DO NOT modify g9d field order without version bump
DO NOT set g9d = p9d (V3 bug anti-regression)
permitted_readonly_actions: Analyze per-step scores, features, and emit decisions on formal parents AFTER completion
Compute joint distributions for diagnostic purposes
Run counterfactual scheduler replay (score-only, env-gate, soft-gate)
Use formal results ONLY for V4 estimate and N5 design guidance
These 20 parents become CONTAMINATED for N5 final evaluation
